subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report access (NDA + bridge letter)
body:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@finanalytics.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + NDA

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. We are preparing for the vendor review for our Q1 procurement and need access to Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report (most recent Type II covering 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31).

Two asks:
1) Would Redwood share the full Type II report under an NDA? We can countersign.
2) If a final Type II isn't available for the exact period, can you provide a bridge letter confirming the audit window and whether any control changes occurred since the last report?

Target timeline: access by 2027-11-22 so our security team can complete their read within the week. Please send the NDA and any instructions for secure delivery (SFTP/secure Drive, redaction rules, or viewer-only links).

Thanks,
Daniel
Head of IT Security
FinAnalytics Inc.

---
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@finanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + NDA

Hi Daniel — thanks for laying this out. We can accommodate both requests but need a few confirmations so we set the right access:

- NDA: attaching our standard Redwood_NDA_v3.2.pdf. Please countersign (we can do DocuSign or return a signed PDF).
- Delivery method: we prefer a viewer-only, expiring Drive link for redacted excerpts and a staged SFTP drop for privileged artifacts. For full privileged report access we require: signed NDA + named reviewers + a 48-hour window to provision one-time access.
- Bridge letter: we have a draft we can provide that confirms audit period and scope; note bridge letters do not include control testing details.
- Redaction: we can provide an audited excerpt with privileged sections redacted (engineering access keys, third-party encryption keys, sensitive customer examples). If you require unredacted content for legal review, we’ll need a mutual redaction process agreed ahead of time.

Marissa, Jordan — looping you in to coordinate countersign and the bridge letter draft.

Dan — I attached the NDA and included a link to the draft bridge letter in Drive. If you sign the NDA today we can aim to provision reviewer access for 11/18 (48-hour lead) or 11/22 as a fallback. Which reviewers should we expect?

Chloe Martin
Manager, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_NDA_v3.2.pdf (pdf)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cRedacted

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@finanalytics.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 12:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + NDA

Daniel — quick follow on process and materials.

- I uploaded a redacted excerpt (SOC2_TypeII_Excerpt_Redacted.pdf) and a bridge-letter template (bridge-letter-draft.docx). These are intended for your security and procurement teams.
- Proposed review cadence: we provision a 7-day view window for the redacted excerpt once the NDA is countersigned. For privileged/full artifacts, we require a scheduled one-hour joint review call with our security lead present.
- Please share the list of named reviewers (full name + email) for access provisioning. For DocuSign we can send the NDA to the email addresses you provide.

If you need the unredacted report for contract/legal review, note we will require an additional mutual redaction step and a signed attestation acknowledging handling controls.

—Marissa
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_Excerpt_Redacted.pdf (pdf), bridge-letter-draft.docx (docx)

---
From: Daniel Park <daniel@finanalytics.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@finanalytics.com
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 16:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge letter + NDA

Thanks — I signed and uploaded the countersigned NDA to your DocuSign link (transaction id: DS-20271115-FA). Named reviewers:
- Eric Wong <eric.wong@finanalytics.com> (InfoSec lead)
- Melissa Ruiz <melissa.ruiz@finanalytics.com> (Procurement)

We can do a joint one-hour review on 2027-11-19 at 10am ET — please confirm Jordan (security) can join. Also, the procurement team may request the unredacted report for legal counsel. If that’s required, we will accept the mutual redaction step and can route the review through our legal contact.

Also: is the bridge letter you mentioned sufficient to confirm the audit period above, or do we need an additional Type II attestation? Our compliance team prefers explicit language about the covered period and whether there were any SOC control exceptions during that period.

Appreciate the speed.

Daniel
Head of IT Security
FinAnalytics Inc.

[Attachment: Countersigned_NDA_FinAnalytics_signed.pdf (pdf) — uploaded to DocuSign]
